title: Part One: Facts, Fulfillment, and Freedom
coreMove: Separate what fate controls from the small response that still belongs to you.
sourcePressure: The later memoir unit emphasizes apathy, arbitrary fate, food fantasies, small acts of comfort, beauty, faith, liberation, bitterness, disillusionment, and a narrow claim of inner freedom.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Do not turn inner freedom into positive thinking or moral blame. The claim must stay narrow: arbitrary fate remains real, damage remains real, and the remaining response may be small.

sourceAnchors.name: liberation
sourceAnchors.detail: The frozen source says liberation is described as unreal and later mixed with bitterness and disillusionment.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Freedom outside the gate may arrive before the damaged person can feel free inside it.

sourceAnchors.name: food fantasies
sourceAnchors.detail: The source notes food fantasies as part of later camp life.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A fantasy about food can show both deprivation and the mind trying to remain alive.

sourceAnchors.name: small acts of comfort
sourceAnchors.detail: The source says scattered acts of comfort and continuing ability to notice beauty still appear amid apathy.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A small decency matters because it is chosen where almost nothing else is.

hook: No one can take your attitude
counterintuition: Circumstances do not matter as much as response

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person 'You' direct address, retrospective 'It took her three weeks to see', question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.domain: long-term rehabilitation ward after a cyclist learns one hand may not fully return
exampleSpecs.audience: an occupational therapist helping a patient distinguish loss from the next chosen practice
exampleSpecs.stakes: false cheer will insult the injury, but total resignation will steal the reachable skill
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the therapist leaves the prognosis paper visible, then asks the patient to choose which shirt button to practice first with the adaptive hook
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The blue shirt hangs from the therapy peg with every button fastened.

exampleSpecs.domain: immigration detention visitor room where a volunteer can offer only one reliable message
exampleSpecs.audience: a legal volunteer facing arbitrary delays she cannot control
exampleSpecs.stakes: promising hope would be cruel, but one accurate next step can preserve dignity
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she crosses out the comforting prediction and writes the one verified filing date on the visitor-room form
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "Do not tell me it will be fine," the man says before sitting down.

exampleSpecs.domain: flooded neighborhood cleanup where insurance decisions are arbitrary and uneven
exampleSpecs.audience: a block captain watching neighbors compare who was approved and who was denied
exampleSpecs.stakes: resentment may swallow the one useful act the block can still coordinate
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the captain stops the argument over adjuster luck and assigns the only shared task: photograph every furnace serial plate before debris pickup
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Mud has dried in a brown ring around the furnace door.

exampleSpecs.domain: burnout leave from a public-defender office where a lawyer cannot repair every failed case
exampleSpecs.audience: a lawyer returning from leave without pretending the system became fair
exampleSpecs.stakes: if she treats every loss as personal failure, she will collapse; if she treats none as personal, she will harden
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: after rereading three closed files, she writes one repairable practice on a sticky note and one unfixable fact below it
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Olivia six months away to stop calling every bad outcome her verdict.

exampleSpecs.domain: nursing home dining room where a son visits a mother who no longer recognizes him
exampleSpecs.audience: an adult child deciding whether love depends on being known in return
exampleSpecs.stakes: the visit may become either performance for recognition or a chosen act without reward
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: you watch him stop correcting her and cut the peach into smaller pieces because care is still available even when recognition is not
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You notice the peach first, untouched on the rim of the plate.

exampleSpecs.domain: remote weather station crew trapped by a storm after supply flight cancellation
exampleSpecs.audience: a field scientist keeping morale from becoming denial
exampleSpecs.stakes: chance controls the flight window, but not the log entry that may protect the next crew
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: when the supply flight is cancelled, she writes the failed assumption into the station log instead of giving another morale speech
exampleSpecs.firstImage: What remains when the plane turns back and nobody has done anything wrong?

skillTargets: protect the narrowness of inner freedom
choose a concrete response under arbitrary conditions
recognize liberation or relief as complicated rather than instantly healing

tryThisNowSpec: Draw two boxes: cannot choose and still can choose. Put one hard fact in the first and one next humane action in the second.

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'
